description: This file contains shell script functions and comments for managing firmware upgrades on Buffalo devices with Mediatek MT7622. It includes device notes, upgrade procedures, validation functions, and U-Boot behaviors related to firmware partition flashing.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image file for compatibility with the device, checking magic values, archive integrity, partition sizes, and image format.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure for TRX + UBI formatted images, including cache dropping, UBI detachment, partition erasure, and writing the new firmware image.
